newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates steady in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates steady in lacklustre trade.

text.p: Pakistan cotton rates remained steady on Saturday in lacklustre trading as mill owners stayed out because of a fund shortage, and dealers said the price would hover around the current levels as demand was low.
"There was little activity today because of low demand from the mill owners," dealer Adil Usman said. "Mill owners stayed out because they have been hit by a liquidity crunch."
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted between 1,900 ($47.09) and 2,100 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
